positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead migration of profile photo data.
Did product and technical discovery, analyzed current user experience, gathered basic performance data, and created technical strategy and roadmap to help team take ownership of invitations feature.
Created invitations platform, enabling teams to build their own product-specific invitation experiences. 
Lead migration of referral evaluation logic, improving performance, ease of modification, and observability.
Executed major refactoring of incentives payments system to end reliance on unstable display identifiers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and lead development of new audience membership system from data ingestion to analytics. Lead downtime-free data migration, validating new system's data was of equal or better quality.
Lead efforts to reduce noise for on-call team, leading to a 50% decrease in the number of escalations without an increase in false negatives.
Reduced infrastructure costs by 16% through careful analysis of cloud service costs to identify inefficiencies.

Lead engineering within Button's Tap business unit, responsible for everything from the product process to project management to system quality and correctness.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Rewrite transaction creation and publisher notifications to help complete order pipeline rework. Design affiliate network integrations and develop affiliate network notifications and logic for handling affiliate network links.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead four person team responsible for design and development of an account creation and upgrade pipeline and an audience creation and syndication platform.

Improve latency of data sampling system by approximately 90%, which made it feasible to scale the system to process the entire data stream and lead to improved data deduplication. Improve latency of device scoring task by approximately 50% at median (and 80% for the slowest events), enabling company to fulfill its goal of evaluating each active device once per day.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop internal metrics reporting library. Design and develop dynamic data persistence verification subsystem for distributed data access system. Improve user segmentation data quality by finding and eliminating unnecessary rate limiting on recently updated keys. Selected to receive departmental award for my work by peers. Organize tech talks series for development organization.
Replace legacy ad auction data ingestion system by integrating with new data pipeline framework, increased amount of data processed by approximately ten times. Design and develop microservice to prevent ingestion of data from blacklisted sources with 99th percentile latency of under a millisecond.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Instant Video
Develop Instant Video web services providing device authentication and registration, second screen, and on-device Prime signup features. Collaborate with teams across Amazon focused on authentication, Instant Video client applications, payments, and Amazon Prime, including development work on Amazon Prime and payments web services. Develop system to continuously update model of display ad performance.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Use MapReduce to find statistics on citations in Wikipedia articles using Wikipedia's XML dumps. 
Macademia (macademia.macalester.edu): Ran MapReduce jobs to calculate similarities between different terms using a Wikipedia dump, documented procedure. Implemented first dynamic algorithm to calculate most similar users. 
Macademia and Poliwiki: Design and implementation of data structures and algorithms. Migrate selected objects from Grails ORM/PostgreSQL to MongoDB.

Experience with Java, Groovy, MapReduce, MongoDB.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Set up client agreement tracking system.
Documented college planning system and created graphics for use in student presentations.
Helped set up firm wiki.

positions.title: Preceptor
positions.description: Teaching assistant for introductory Computer Science course.  Created answer keys, graded homework, held help sessions.

publications.title: Getting to the Source: Where does Wikipedia Get Its Information From?
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 9th International Symposium on Wikis and Open Collaboration, WikiSym · Jan 1, 2013
